text: Program Description I Name Dual-degree for Bachelor Program of Chinese Language & Business II Overview This program mainly aims to cultivate a systematic knowledge of Chinese language and Chinese culture, master the basic knowledge and theories of Chinese society, history, literature, philosophy and cross-cultural communication, can adapt to the development needs of global economic integration, have good business ethics and international business skills, be familiar with international business theory, integrated management. The theoretical knowledge of economics, law and other disciplines is an export-oriented, application-oriented and compound talent who can skillfully use Chinese in international business operations. The program is a 4-year program, which offers two degrees in Bachelor of ARTS and MANAGENMENT. Students who complete the academic plan will receive a diploma in the Chinese Language Major, (Bachelor Degree in Arts and Management). Ⅲ Courses Offered Chinese Courses: Comprehensive Chinese, Reading, Writing, News Listening & Reading, Chinese History and Culture, Classic Chinese Modern and Contemporary Literature, Ancient Chinese Literature Classics, Comparison of Chinese and Foreign Cultures and Intercultural Communication, Ancient Chinese philosophy. Business Courses: Accounting, Statistics， Economic Law, Management, International Logistics, International Business, Chinese business history and culture, International Trade Practice, International marketing, International business correspondence, Organizational Behavior, International Finance, International Business Negotiation, etc.
